HCP label — Hepatic (proposed redline): "Hepatic effects: Elevations of ALT and AST were observed in clinical trials; obtain baseline liver tests and repeat at 2–4 weeks and periodically thereafter. Interrupt therapy if ALT or AST ≥3×ULN with symptoms of liver injury or ≥5×ULN without symptoms. Patient leaflet — allergy counseling (proposed bullet): "Stop taking [product] and get medical help right away if you develop rash or hives, swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat, or trouble breathing; do not take [product] again."
